name: YAKSHA SPORTS SIRRUSH SPECIAL JERSEY
description: Crafted by Yaksha Sports, the Sirrush Special Jersey embodies mythical power and cultural artistry. Draped in deep imperial maroon, the fabric is alive with golden dragons and ancient circular motifs, accented by a structured collar and the iconic Sirrush crest. A statement piece where heritage meets modern streetwear elegance.

name: LATINA 26/27 HOME JERSEY
description: A design born from the heart of the city, expressing its most authentic historical identity. The jersey is inspired by the gardens of Piazza del Popolo in Latina, a symbol of the city’s foundation, originally Littoria, where order and symmetry define the urban space. The geometric layouts of the flowerbeds are transformed into a distinctive and recognizable pattern, interwoven with the iconic black-and-blue stripes, blending sporting tradition with architectural heritage. The original concept by Pierluigi Bossi thus becomes a reflection of its era, reinterpreted to proudly represent the territory, both on and off the pitch.

name: PORTOFINO 26/27 SPECIAL JERSEY
description: Inspired by Portofino's iconic Piazzetta, the Portofino Football Club Special Away Jersey turns one of Italy's most recognisable landscapes into a story you can wear. The village's pastel facades unfold across the entire jersey, blending with maritime pines and Mediterranean greenery into one continuous panorama that wraps around the front, back and sleeves. Below, the sea mirrors the harbour's facades in an exclusive tone-on-tone pattern. Above, the design turns deliberately essential, a soft landscape suspended in morning mist, leaving room for the club's new crest to take centre stage: the Portofino Lighthouse, long a guide for those arriving from the sea, now the symbol of the club's renewed identity.

name: SORRENTO 26/27 LIGEA JERSEY
description: One single illustration runs throughout the entire collection. The tails of Partenope, Leucosia and Ligea intertwine with the movement of the sea currents, transforming the three jerseys into three fragments of the same legend. The Ligea Jersey takes the story into the depths of the sea. The black background evokes the abyss, where light fades and the myth takes on its most mysterious dimension. From this darkness, Ligea’s red tail emerges, creating a striking contrast between the depths of the sea and the light of the surface.

name: SORRENTO 25/26 AWAY JERSEY
description: The Away jersey is inspired by the Mediterranean charm of the Sorrento Peninsula. Its pattern echoes the iconic style of hand-painted stone tables, adorned with natural motifs typical of the region. The yellow of lemons, the orange of citrus fruits, and the white of sunlight infuse the jersey with vibrant shades that reflect the authentic and refined soul of Sorrento.

name: TIVOLI 26/27 SPECIAL JERSEY
description: The Fourth jersey is the most iconic and celebratory piece in the collection. A work of art in which the architecture of Tivoli comes to life. The battlemented towers of Rocca Pia, symbol of the papal authority of Pope Pius II, rise across the shoulders and sleeves. At the center of the jersey, the baroque scenography of the Organ Fountain of Villa d'Este unfolds, its jets of water falling like a symphony of light. On the back, the cliffs of Tivoli open onto the waters of the Aniene, which for millennia have sculpted the landscape of the city. Every element is rendered in the warm tones of stone at sunset: the sand of travertine, the gold of the sun setting the gardens ablaze, the brown of centuries-old cypress trees. A fresco of ancient walls and Mediterranean light. A painterly homage to the eternal city beyond Rome, where history is not memory but living matter.

name: SORRENTO 26/27 LEUCOSIA JERSEY
description: One single illustration runs throughout the entire collection. The tails of Partenope, Leucosia and Ligea intertwine with the movement of the sea currents, transforming the three jerseys into three fragments of the same legend. White is not simply a color choice, but a direct reference to the origin of the name Leucosia, from the Greek leukós , meaning “white” and “bright.” The jersey interprets the Siren through light: white evokes the reflections of the sun on the surface of the Mediterranean and the foam of the waves, while the intense red of her tail emerges in a striking contrast. A composition suspended between light, sea and myth.

name: SORRENTO 26/27 PARTENOPE JERSEY
description: One single illustration runs throughout the entire collection. The tails of Partenope, Leucosia and Ligea intertwine with the movement of the ocean currents, transforming the three jerseys into three fragments of the same legend. The Partenope Jersey pays homage to Partenope, the Siren mythologically linked to the origins of Naples.According to legend, after her death, her body reached the shores of the city that would later bear her name, giving rise to the term “Partenopean.” The blue of the sea and sky merges with the Partenopean colors, while deeper shades define the Siren’s tails.

name: LATINA 26/27 AWAY JERSEY
description: A design born from the heart of the city, telling the story of its most authentic historical identity. The jersey draws inspiration from the gardens of Piazza del Popolo in Latina, the symbolic heart of the city's foundation, originally Littoria, where order and symmetry define the urban landscape. The Away jersey showcases the complete layout of the historic square, reproduced through a contrasting central panel and a subtle tone-on-tone pattern across the entire fabric, highlighting every detail of its original urban design. The geometric shapes of the gardens are transformed into an elegant all-over pattern, striking a balance between football tradition and architectural heritage. Pierluigi Bossi's original design is reinterpreted as a contemporary tribute to the city's history, proudly celebrating the identity of the territory, both on and off the pitch.

name: LATINA 26/27 HOME JERSEY LONG SLEEVE
description: A design born from the heart of the city, expressing its most authentic historical identity. The jersey is inspired by the gardens of Piazza del Popolo in Latina, a symbol of the city’s foundation, originally Littoria, where order and symmetry define the urban space. name: LATINA 26/27 PRE-MATCH JERSEY
description: A design born from the heart of Latina, celebrating the city's most authentic urban identity. The Pre-Match Jersey draws inspiration from the layout of the Gardens of Piazza del Popolo, the symbolic heart of the city designed by Pier Luigi Bossi, where order, symmetry and Rationalist architecture define the urban landscape. The entire plan of the square comes to life through an all-over graphic built from layered elements, architectural lines and contrasting geometries that create a dynamic three-dimensional effect. A contemporary visual language that transforms the original urban design into a bold, striking pattern. A tribute to the history and identity of Latina, reinterpreted through a modern lens to accompany the club both on and off the pitch.

name: LATINA 25/26 HOME JERSEY
description: A tribute to the flag of Saint Mark, a symbol of unity among the populations that gave rise to the city of Littoria, now known as Latina. The cult of Saint Mark represents a precious heritage left by Venetian settlers following the reclamation of the Pontine Marshes. The Home jersey becomes a true “Flag Jersey,” where the traditional stripes give way to the Winged Lion dominating the entire kit. The collar and sleeve edges are adorned with the historic inscription "Pax Tibi Marce, Evangelista Meus" , a solemn tribute to the city’s patron saint.

name: TIVOLI 26/27 HOME JERSEY
description: The Home jersey pays homage to the most authentic identity of Tivoli. On the amaranth background, the historic color of the Club, the new logo stands majestically, a renewed emblem of a century-old history. The pattern evokes the decorative elegance and heraldry of the Este family: lilies, rosettes and ornamental geometries intertwine in a design rich in history and memory. The navy blue collar and cuffs, finished with a thin silver line, give the jersey a classic, almost ceremonial elegance, worthy of Tibur Superbum.

name: LATINA SIBÒ 24/25 JERSEY
description: The jersey pays homage to the futurist art of Pierluigi Bossi, known as Sibò. It takes us on a journey through the history of the city, from the founding of Littoria to present-day Latina. The artist's visionary eyes transform rationalist architecture into vibrant explosions of geometry and color. Sibò's paintings are an eternal testimony to man's victory over nature and the great reclamation of the Pontine Marshes.

name: LATINA 24/25 HOME JERSEY
description: The sorceress Circe lived on the island of Eea, now known as the Circeo Promontory. Located in the province of Latina, it is a unique and iconic place, a historical and naturalistic reference point for the entire Pontine coast. Homer recounts the encounter between Ulysses and the sorceress Circe in the tenth book of the Odyssey, an episode depicted on a famous 5th-century BC vase attributed to Persephone. The black and blue stripes are inspired by the floral and Greek geometric patterns that decorate this ancient vase.

name: TIVOLI 26/27 AWAY JERSEY
description: The Away jersey reinterprets the Home design in a brighter key. On the pure white background, the new logo stands out majestically, a renewed emblem of a century-old history. The pattern evokes the decorative elegance and heraldry of the Este family: lilies, rosettes and ornamental geometries intertwine in a design rich in history and memory. The delicate tone-on-tone play of transparencies evokes travertine, the stone of Tivoli par excellence, the material with which the monuments of Rome have been built for two thousand years. The navy blue collar and cuffs, finished with a thin silver line, give the jersey a classic, almost ceremonial elegance, worthy of Tibur Superbum.

name: TIVOLI 26/27 THIRD JERSEY
description: The Third jersey is a work of art. Against a deep blue background, the architecture of Tivoli comes to life. The battlemented towers of Rocca Pia, symbol of the papal authority of Pope Pius II, rise across the shoulders and sleeves. At the center of the jersey, the baroque scenography of the Organ Fountain of Villa d'Este unfolds, its jets of water falling like a symphony of light. On the back, the cliffs of Tivoli open onto the waters of the Aniene, which for millennia have sculpted the landscape of the city. Every detail is hand-painted, every waterfall is a memory: a jersey that transforms whoever wears it into a guardian of Tiburtine beauty.

name: BOREALE 23/24 THIRD JERSEY
description: The third jersey pays homage to Christ's monogram “Chi-Rho” and the famous phrase “In Hoc Signo Vinces.” According to legend, the night before the battle, after having a vision of the Cross, an angel appeared to Constantine in a dream and ordered him to place the “Chi-Rho” sign, Christ's monogram, on his soldiers' shields. For this reason, the jersey features a contrasting golden cross pattern, decorated with a geometric motif that combines the “Chi-Rho” sign and the famous phrase “In Hoc Signo Vinces” in a single pattern.

name: BOREALE 25/26 THIRD JERSEY
description: The wonderful Christian mosaics decorating the vaults of the Mausoleum of Santa Costanza are among the oldest still preserved in Rome. The third 25/26 jersey is inspired by depictions of nature, enriched with plant elements such as flowers and fruits, animals such as doves and peacocks, and Christian baptismal symbols such as amphorae, cups, and saucers. The mausoleum was built in the mid-4th century to house the relics of Constantina, daughter of Constantine, venerated by the Catholic Church under the name of Saint Constance.

name: SORRENTO 80TH ANNIVERSARY JERSEY
description: The Sorrento 80th Anniversary jersey pays tribute to the 1970/71 away kit, the year of the club’s historic promotion to Serie B. Back then, the kit was white, defined by its signature red-and-black diagonal sash. Today, in our modern reinterpretation, that sash is shaped by the diamond pattern of the Sorrento crest, an iconic symbol of the city. Subtle tone-on-tone wooden inlays, inspired by Sorrento’s artisan tradition, enrich the design and strengthen its bond with the local heritage. Details such as the club’s founding date on the back of the collar and the commemorative crest where the number 80 embraces the five diamonds give the jersey an exclusive character, making it a true must-have for collectors.

name: LATINA 25/26 THIRD JERSEY
description: A tribute to the flag of Saint Mark, a symbol of unity among the populations that gave rise to the city of Littoria, now known as Latina. The cult of Saint Mark represents a precious heritage left by Venetian settlers following the reclamation of the Pontine Marshes. The Third jersey draws inspiration from the decorative elements of a rare historic flag, preserved in the archives of Venice, authentic treasures of art and tradition. In elegant crimson red and gold shades, it is a clear homage, in both colors and shapes, to the legendary golden flames, a distinctive feature of the Flag of Saint Mark and a symbol of strength and justice. The tone-on-tone high-frequency pattern further enhances the jersey, adding depth, light-and-shadow effects, and a luminous finish.

name: SORRENTO 25/26 HOME JERSEY
description: The Home jersey pays tribute to the ancient art of Sorrentine marquetry. Its decorative patterns are inspired by an elegant and refined early 20th-century writing desk preserved at the Correale Museum in Sorrento. The red and black stripes intertwine harmoniously with the five diamonds that have symbolized the city for centuries. The jersey’s pattern is entirely composed of tiny wooden tiles fragments of memory that evoke the meticulous craftsmanship of local artisans.

name: KPLER 26/27 HOME JERSEY
description: The Home Jersey is the beating heart of the Ezeta × Kpler capsule. Its pattern is born from the encounter between the vivid red of Kpler's global campaign and the deep black of Ezeta's identity, two colors that don't blend but collide, generating energy. Red stripes burst from the center of the body outward, inspired by the coat of a tiger caught mid-run. Each line opens and closes like a muscle under tension, capturing an instant of speed held still on the fabric. At the center of the chest, the double signature of Ezeta and Kpler. Above it, the hexagonal patch of the collaboration, the symbol of a union that asks for no permission.

name: LATINA 25/26 AWAY JERSEY
description: A tribute to the flag of Saint Mark, a symbol of unity among the populations that gave rise to the city of Littoria, now known as Latina. The cult of Saint Mark represents a precious heritage left by Venetian settlers following the reclamation of the Pontine Marshes. Inspired by the oriental floral motifs found on the historic Flag of Saint Mark, it symbolizes the meeting of cultures and artistic refinement. name: KPLER 26/27 AWAY JERSEY
description: The Away jersey is the luminous side of the Ezeta × Kpler capsule. Its pattern is built on a white base crossed by red and black stripes that open from the center of the body outward. The white is not a background, but an open space: the stillness that lets movement breathe. The red lines carry the energy of Kpler's global campaign, while the black draws their contours, giving depth to every stripe. Inspired by the coat of a tiger caught mid-run, the jersey turns animal instinct into a clean, almost graphic image. Speed, safety and pride move here in full light. At the center of the chest, the double signature of Ezeta and Kpler. Above it, the hexagonal patch of the collaboration.

name: KPLER 26/27 THIRD JERSEY
description: The Third jersey is the nocturnal side of the Ezeta × Kpler capsule. Its pattern is built on a black base crossed by grey and anthracite stripes that open from the center of the body outward. The colors move in a quieter register, made of dark tones layered for depth rather than contrast. Red gives way to grey, and the energy of Kpler's global campaign translates into a more restrained presence, almost camouflaged. Inspired by the coat of a tiger caught mid-run, the jersey turns animal instinct into a nocturnal image, where movement hides inside the shadow. Speed, safety and pride move here below the surface. At the center of the chest, the double signature of Ezeta and Kpler. Above it, the hexagonal patch of the collaboration.

name: LATINA 24/25 AWAY JERSEY

name: VIS AURELIA 25/26 HOME JERSEY
description: The Home Jersey draws inspiration from the natural and harmonious forms of the Corinthian capital, a symbol of classical Roman aesthetics. Legend has it that in Corinth, a young maiden passed away. Her nurse, filled with grief, placed upon her tomb a basket filled with keepsakes and tokens of affection. From the earth sprouted an acanthus plant whose leaves, as they grew, gently curled around the basket, wrapping sorrow in grace. Callimachus saw this marvel of nature and, captivated by its beauty, carved in stone what nature had shaped with the wind. Thus, nature became architecture, and sorrow, transformed into form, found its eternity in art.

name: SORRENTO 25/26 AWAY GOALKEEPER JERSEY

name: BOREALE 23/24 HOME JERSEY
description: The home jersey is inspired by the Battle of Milvian Bridge, fought in 312 AD, which marked Constantine's victory over Maxentius and the triumph of Christianity over the pagan world. The battle is immortalized in a famous painting by Raphael's school, created in 1520 and preserved in the Vatican Museums. This timeless work of art is framed by a central band, with contrasting collar and sleeve edges, and a tone-on-tone purple pattern across the entire jersey.

name: BOREALE 24/25 AWAY JERSEY
description: After his victorious battle at Milvian Bridge, Constantine became the first Christian emperor. The jersey pays tribute to the Chi-Rho monogram of Christ and the famous phrase “In Hoc Signo Vinces,” sacred and iconic elements that led Constantine to triumph.

name: OSTIAMARE 24/25 FOURTH JERSEY
description: The fourth jersey is inspired by the wonderful depictions on the walls of the cloister inside the X Municipio building in Ostia, located in the city center and built between 1924 and 1926. All these graphic elements come together in a tone-on-tone pattern of wheat yellow across the entire jersey, further enriched by a contrasting black horizontal band, collar, and sleeve edges.

The photos from the presentation are inspired by the style of Caravaggio, who painted the figure of Bacchus several times during his lifetime.

This basilica, besides being the oldest church in the West, is the cathedral of Rome and boasts a rich collection of works of art and decorations of all kinds. The jersey is inspired by the precious gilded coffered ceiling, designed by Michelangelo and later created by Daniele da Volterra on commission from Popes Pius IV and Pius V.

description: The Home Shorts draws inspiration from the natural and harmonious forms of the Corinthian capital, a symbol of classical Roman aesthetics. Legend has it that in Corinth, a young maiden passed away. Her nurse, filled with grief, placed upon her tomb a basket filled with keepsakes and tokens of affection. From the earth sprouted an acanthus plant whose leaves, as they grew, gently curled around the basket, wrapping sorrow in grace. Callimachus saw this marvel of nature and, captivated by its beauty, carved in stone what nature had shaped with the wind. Thus, nature became architecture, and sorrow, transformed into form, found its eternity in art.

name: LATINA 26/27 AWAY JERSEY YOUTH
description: A design born from the heart of the city, telling the story of its most authentic historical identity. The jersey draws inspiration from the gardens of Piazza del Popolo in Latina, the symbolic heart of the city's foundation, originally Littoria, where order and symmetry define the urban landscape. The Away jersey showcases the complete layout of the historic square, reproduced through a contrasting central panel and a subtle tone-on-tone pattern across the entire fabric, highlighting every detail of its original urban design. The geometric shapes of the gardens are transformed into an elegant all-over pattern, striking a balance between football tradition and architectural heritage. Pierluigi Bossi's original design is reinterpreted as a contemporary tribute to the city's history, proudly celebrating the identity of the territory, both on and off the pitch.
